title: Da Lat in two days
summary: The lake, the market, the cathedral, the station, and Bao Dai’s villa on the first day. Truc Lam and Datanla on the second, then the market slope after dark.

days.title: Day 1 — The lake and the town
days.body: Xuan Huong Lake, the market, the cathedral on Tran Phu, the college gate on Yersin, and the station, then Bao Dai’s villa about 2.5 km south and Lam Vien Square on the lake edge.

days.title: Day 2 — Truc Lam and Datanla
days.body: The cable car from Robin Hill to Truc Lam on Phoenix Hill, then Datanla on Prenn Pass, and the market slope after dark.

stops.name: Xuan Huong Lake
stops.note: Day one begins with a loop of the shore, which takes 45 to 90 minutes.

stops.name: Da Lat Market
stops.note: Day one in the sloping halls, for produce and flowers.

stops.name: Da Lat Cathedral
stops.note: Day one at the rooster tower on Tran Phu.

approach.note: Walk from the lake to Tran Phu.

stops.name: Da Lat Education College
stops.note: Day one at the colonnade and the bell tower on Yersin.

stops.name: Da Lat Railway Station
stops.note: Day one in the art-deco hall, 30 to 60 minutes without the train.

approach.note: Walk or take a taxi from the lake.

stops.name: Bao Dai Palace III
stops.note: Day one in the rooms and the garden at 1 Trieu Viet Vuong.

approach.note: Taxi to 1 Trieu Viet Vuong, about 2.5 km south.

stops.name: Lam Vien Square
stops.note: Day one ends on the paved square at the lake edge.

approach.note: Walk from the lake to Tran Quoc Toan.

stops.name: Truc Lam Zen Monastery
stops.note: Day two in the gardens on Phoenix Hill, 1 to 2 hours with the cable car.

approach.note: Taxi to the Robin Hill station, then the cable car.

stops.name: Datanla Falls
stops.note: Day two at the cascade on Prenn Pass.

approach.note: Taxi over Prenn Pass from the lake.

stops.name: Da Lat Night Market
stops.note: Day two on the same slope after dark, from about 18:00 to 23:00.

approach.note: Walk up from the lake after dark.

additions.name: Linh Phuoc Pagoda
additions.note: The mosaic pagoda at Trai Mat, by the tourist train from the station or by road.

additions.name: Crazy House
additions.note: The concrete rooms and bridges at 03 Huynh Thuc Khang.

additions.name: Domaine de Marie
additions.note: The convent church at 1 Ngo Quyen on the west ridge.

additions.name: Langbiang Mountain
additions.note: The mountain north of town at 93A Bidoup, a half-day from the centre.

additions.name: Valley of Love
additions.note: The landscaped park north of the centre.

additions.name: Elephant Falls
additions.note: The wide fall at Nam Ban, about 30 km from town, a half-day with the drive.

seoDescription: Two days in Da Lat: the lake and the town, then Truc Lam by cable car from Robin Hill and Datanla on Prenn Pass.
